title: Jeepney Simulator
description:
OVERVIEWDrive through the busy streets of Dabbo City on iconic Filipino jeepneys. Pick up passengers, return their change, and drop them off at their destination. Use your hard-earned income to feed your family, buy furniture, and pay your rent. Or spend it on upgrades and customization options for your jeeps.IMMERSIVE GAMEPLAY
Take a walk to the garage, push the engine button, and switch your gear! Become the jeepney driver!CUSTOMIZATION
Upgrade your jeepney's speed, fuel efficiency, and fuel capacity. Paint it to one of many colors. Golden jeepney, anyone?REALISTIC TRAFFIC SYSTEM
Navigate the busy streets and weave through traffic!FAMILY MANAGEMENT
Manage your family's health and happiness by interacting with them, buying furniture, and picking the right choices in randomized events!HIRAYA CORPORATION
Discover the secrets of a megacorporation as it slowly starts to take over the country...
description_short: Embrace your inner jeepney driver! Pick up passengers, calculate change, and weave through traffic in this Filipino-made driving game. Feed your family, customize your jeepneys, and unlock more rides! Don't forget to bring your towel!
